message.reasoning:
We need to produce formative feedback JSON. Must address student as "you". Be specific, supportive, actionable: cite sections/figures, name what they did well, state what next rubric level requires. Do not change marks. Do not comment on document-conversion artefacts. Do not make up explanations for reasoning given by marking agent unclear/incomplete.

Schema: summary <=80 words, next_steps array of 3 strings, criteria object mapping criterion id to feedback <=70 words each.

Need ensure one JSON object only. No markdown.

Need feedback per criterion C1-C4. Summary overall concise. Next steps three actionable. Use specific citations: Introduction, Mission Design – Launch, Orbit, Ground Control & Communications, Mission Duration & EOL, Conclusion, Bibliography, Image 1-2. Mention STK screenshots, missing STK files, Vega E not operational, RAAN, resolution contradiction, EOL no thrusters/passive drag sail/no deorbit lifetime, no link/data-rate/ground-station compatibility, referencing Wikipedia/bare URLs/missing [50]. But keep each criterion <=70 words. Need not mention all in each.

C1 feedback: You cover primary mission, Australian benefit, single satellite rationale and users in Introduction, but operator/customer roles not clearly separated and referencing weak/inappropriate. To reach Accomplished, clearly distinguish operator vs customers, add specific literature references and detail. <=70 words. Address as you. Good.

C2: You address launch, orbit, ground access, duration/EOL with STK screenshots and some calculations. However Vega E not operational and 2021 manifest weak; RAAN 27.33° claim; "high altitude...low resolution desirable" contradictory; EOL maneuver inconsistent with no thrusters/passive drag sail/no deorbit lifetime; no link/data-rate/ground-station compatibility; missing STK files. To reach Accomplished, provide operational launch vehicle justification, correct orbital-element reasoning, consistent EOL with calculated deorbit lifetime, link budget and software files. Need <=70 words. This is many. Can pack. Maybe 70 words exactly? We'll craft concise.

C3: Conclusion summarises launch/SSO/ground station and links to reef monitoring, but generic and omits limitations/performance evidence. To reach Accomplished, tie conclusions explicitly to evidence (link budget, access, orbit, EOL) and state limitations/risks. <=70.

C4: Structure/headings/writing generally clear, but figures/tables lack consistent numbering; references bare URLs incl Wikipedia and missing cited entries ([50]); Image 1-2 label etc. To reach Accomplished, number/caption all figures/tables consistently, use quality references with full entries matching in-text citations, polish formatting. <=70.

Next_steps: three. 1 revise C2 technical: replace Vega E with operational LV or strong justification; correct RAAN/SSO reasoning; fix resolution statement; reconcile EOL with passive drag sail and calculate deorbit lifetime. 2 add communications sizing: link budget/data rate and ground-station compatibility; include STK software files. 3 referencing/presentation: replace Wikipedia/bare URLs, add missing [50], consistent figure/table numbering/captions. Maybe also C1 operator/customer separation and conclusion evidence. Need exactly 3 strings. Could combine.

Summary <=80 words: "You have a coherent single-satellite coral-reef mission with STK evidence and most required elements. Main weaknesses are launch-vehicle feasibility, orbital-element justification, EOL/manoeuvre consistency, communications sizing, missing STK files, and referencing/formatting. Your marks are unchanged; the feedback below identifies what to do to move each criterion toward Accomplished." Count ~55. Good. Avoid saying marks unchanged? It's okay.

Need no markdown. JSON object only. Need valid JSON. Use escaped quotes? Strings can contain apostrophes. Avoid newlines? Can include. Need ensure no unescaped double quotes within strings. Use single quotes or avoid. But JSON strings use double quotes; inside use apostrophes or escaped. Avoid citations with quotes? We can write RAAN 27.33° etc. Use 97.7924° maybe. Use "high altitude yielding low resolution is desirable" would require escaping; can phrase as your statement that high altitude yielding low resolution is desirable. No double quotes. Fine. Use [50] okay.

Need criterion keys "C1" etc. Word counts.
